# galaxy-dev-skills (mirror)

Everything under `skills/` is a verbatim copy of the `dev-skills/` tree upstream;
**do not edit it here**. Upstream: https://github.com/galaxyproject/galaxy-skills.
The pinned commit is recorded in `UPSTREAM.json`.

These are the skills for *building* Galaxy -- tool wrappers, Nextflow conversion,
ToolShed revisions, track hubs, Hub news posts. The skills for *using* Galaxy live in
the `galaxy-skills` plugin, which mirrors the upstream `skills/` tree. Upstream keeps
them apart so that installing one doesn't hand you the other.

Refresh with `scripts/sync-skills.sh` from the repository root (a scheduled
GitHub Action does this weekly and opens a pull request). The manifests in
this directory are regenerated by `scripts/gen-manifests.py`.
